#+title: Generated list-by commands carry two template nits
#+description: Every generated entity's repository and service .cpp has two consecutive blank lines after the list-by methods, and every generated by-column shell command's usage text omits --scope, which its parser accepts and its service then rejects for subtree. Both come from the codegen templates and appear identically in every entity with a list-by foreign key.
#+type: capture
#+level: cross
#+filetags: 
#+created: 2026-10-02
#+updated: 2026-10-02

This page is a [[id:671F18E4-E09C-4B3B-BD24-D33DF8AE38A6][capture]] in the *inbox* bucket of the product backlog — a pre-sprint idea, not yet pulled into a sprint as a story.

* What

Every generated entity with a =:list_by:= foreign key gets a list-by method in
its repository and service, and a =by-column= verb in the shell. Two small
defects come with it, identically in every such entity:
- the repository and service =.cpp= files carry two consecutive blank lines
  after the list-by methods (=credit_simulation_config= and
  =pricing_model_config= both show three such places in each file);
- the shell verb's usage text omits =--scope=, which its parser accepts and its
  service then rejects with an explicit code for =subtree=.

* Why

Both come from the templates, so fixing one entity's output by hand would only
drift from its template. The usage text matters more: it hides an option the
parser takes, and the option then fails. Either the parser should stop
accepting =--scope= for these verbs, or the usage should list it.
